capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Ford 2025 spec sheet: ER 88 kWh usable (360 cells); Ford Canada 2026 Premium page also lists 88 kWh. Earlier ER was 91 kWh (376 cells).

chemistry.notes: Estimated: ER packs through 2024 are NCM (InsideEVs 2023, relays Ford). The 2025 ER pack changed (360 cells instead of 376, 2025 Ford sheet) but no chemistry change was reported, so NCM is the likely chemistry, not a proven one.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: Mach-E LFP pack reads 347.8 V nominal (Electrek); the NMC packs share the same architecture, so 400 V class. Class inferred from the figure.

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: Ford Canada says its electric vehicles use navigation-triggered battery preconditioning (route planning or choosing a DC fast charger in Connected Navigation, Google Maps or Apple Maps EV Routing). The cited page is silent on any manual control and on model years; I found no manual battery-preconditioning control documented in Ford support pages or owner forums (owners have asked for one since 2021), so automatic_with_navigation is the best fit, not a proven fact.

dc_max_kw.notes: Ford 2025 spec sheet: up to 150 kW DC fast charge.

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: Wikipedia infobox lists 11 kW onboard AC for the Mach-E (Ford owners cite 10.5 kW output / 11.3-11.5 kW at 48 A); no onboard-charger change found 2021-2026. Wikipedia does not name a market, so the Canadian car is unproven.
